title: At the Hollow Throne, 'weigh the doors of the seat' reports 'No oil yet: the Ironbound keep casks at Cinderhall, and the palace has its own' and the burn option never appears — despite my carrying an item literally named 'cask of cinder-oil' (from Factor Corrin at Emberfall) the whole time. Nothing earlier disclosed that this oil was single-location-bound to the Emberfall chapel rather than a generic reusable resource.
where: The Hollow Throne (Marrowgate) / carried item 'cask of cinder-oil'
